bounded_scope: Contemporary standard written Mandarin used by current Pointfire inputs and public essays; readable-aloud prose included; dialects, Classical Chinese and historical varieties excluded unless separately annotated.
nonessentialist_limit: Describes grammatical resources, discourse tendencies and permitted variation, never every Chinese speaker, genre, region or civilization.

ordinary_discourse: topic chains, zero anaphora, aspect marking and genre-sensitive clause linkage described in reference grammar and discourse studies

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Topic-comment organization and topic chains are productive; subject-predicate clauses are also ordinary.
transformation_risks: fixed subjects invented during English-oriented normalization

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Agency may be overt, omitted, backgrounded or encoded with disposal/passive/change-of-state constructions.
transformation_risks: agent invented for an agentless event
counterexamples_and_variation: agency choice depends on verb and discourse

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Aspect particles, temporal expressions, lexical aspect and context organize event contour; no one-to-one mapping to English tense.
transformation_risks: 了 mapped to simple past by default
counterexamples_and_variation: bare verbs can receive temporal interpretation from context

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Evidence source and certainty are normally lexical, modal or report-structural rather than obligatory morphology.
counterexamples_and_variation: unmarked assertions may still have documented provenance outside the sentence
open_questions: interaction of sentence-final particles and stance across varieties

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Arguments and pronouns may be omitted when discourse makes them recoverable; topic chains can span clauses.
Juxtaposition, order, rhythm and explicit connectives jointly encode clause relations.
counterexamples_and_variation: academic Chinese can be highly connective-explicit
open_questions: automatic distinction between licensed inference and invented logic

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Directional and result complements and verb compounds can jointly encode manner, path and result.
transformation_risks: path/result lost in a generic target verb
counterexamples_and_variation: multiple constructions are available for the same event

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Context/topic often precedes the new assertion, but order remains genre- and purpose-sensitive.
Address terms, pronouns, politeness expressions, sentence-final resources and viewpoint encode social stance without one unified honorific paradigm.
Classifiers, compounding, terminology and context choose category granularity.
counterexamples_and_variation: professional vocabularies vary and borrowing is productive

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Clause units and punctuation organize breathing; both long and short sentences can be idiomatic.
counterexamples_and_variation: medium and author voice strongly affect judgment
open_questions: human read-aloud adjudication cannot be automated

dimensions.grammar_or_convention: Modern written Chinese contains academic, journalistic, public-essay, colloquial and diverse literary registers.
counterexamples_and_variation: writers shift register within and across works
open_questions: work-specific markedness gain requires human review

inbound_outbound_summary: English-to-Chinese: do not retain an abstract subject-centered clause frame merely by replacing words.
Chinese-to-English: overt subjects, articles, tense and connectives added for well-formedness require framing review.
Chinese internal revision: omission and parataxis are resources, not automatic goals; ambiguity and claim boundaries control their use.
